reviews.review: Total Biscuits fandom for 40k games deceived me. Corridor shooter with a lot of invisible walls. It just feels so extremely consoly.
Best Warhammer experience to date, needs a second

hmmmm. .i can say that this game is much better than eternal crusade.

dont get me wrong, i didnt said the other game is so bad + worst and this game is like perfect game. every game has a flaw.

this game do has a flaw. and the more severe flaw is. . there is no server. it depend on the host. and its so very annoying when you on focus to shoot the heretics then "migrating host" is pop out on your screen. that is why i add some new tag to this store " migrate host simulator"

despite that, this game is good, even tough i got difficult playing the single player campaign ( almost at that ) . the gameplay is fun 3rd person shooter and many weapon present from iconic W40K series.

the grapic is good too, the space marine, the imperial guard, the orks, and the chaos has good visual. including the warband sets in multiplayer mode.

the sound is so clear. the sound of bolter , the zip sound of lazcannon etc , its has a vibe of w40k weapon.

what make me sad is, the game on multiplayer mode. people never want to play at dreadnough assault. yeah i know you should have the dlc first, but then, when ppl already purchased the dlc, then wanna to try but there is no match going on at dreadnought assault mode ? is so salty. . hope some one who read this, may rally other player to play dreadnought assault :( , and most lots of ppl playing at versus classic. . this is so much basic for all multiplayer shooting based game all year.

so, do i reccomended this game, i can say yes if you so much into the w40k fans. or just want to find new sensation with the w40k feel if you are new.
Ok so... i never played one of the warhammer games and i bought this one because it looked good and i wasent let down one bit so far so good

The healing system in this game is a gigantic bag of ass.  I don't want to go through some lengthy execution animation in the middle of a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ firefight, just so I can regain my health.   Half the time I ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ die, and then the smarmy reload screen "reminds" me to perform executions to regain health.  

I hope the people who made this game find themselves drowning, and then someone shouts at them that there's a life vest 50ft below the surface of the water.  

The rest of the game is fine by comparison, but ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ is it annoying to regain health.
